notes: This readiness file intentionally blocks live v2 execution.
The v2 Render-trigger workflow must fail before provider execution while v1FallbackSuppressionBound is false or owner authority is not activation-ready.
The durable #509 approval ref remains runtime input rather than checked-in state so the approval can bind the already-existing exact activation revision without changing that revision SHA.

At execution time the workflow must fetch the referenced #509 issue comment and verify repository OWNER identity, exact authorizedRevisionSha, canonical rebaseline authorization, new-generation provider execution authorization, and scheduler cutover authorization.
Render dispatch mutation is an external action performed only after an activation-ready revision is merged and separately authorized.
The existing v1 Render scheduler and GitHub fallback remain untouched by this candidate.
